measured_on: 2026-08-16, throwaway clone of lab-omnibus-state-v1 on clusterio-host-1-instance-1
method: create_entity on a platform surface, validity read on the CREATING tick, then repeated area censuses; a second run sampled the same three types over 7001 ticks in two arms (as created, and after an attempted freeze)

entries.reason: it does not survive long enough to be banked: a banked fixture is loaded and censused minutes to months after it was written, and this cell would be absent every time, so a MISSING verdict would report the fixture broken rather than the type transient; the sweep runner places it fresh and exports within its lifetime instead
entries.measurement: create_entity returned a valid entity on the creating tick (tick 31874068) and the type was absent from an area census 38 ticks later; it never reappeared across a 7001-tick window. LuaEntity.active is READ-ONLY at 2.1.11 ('LuaEntity::active is read only.'), so the cell cannot be frozen in place to outlive the window
